records.title: Romanian Government (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) Scholarships for non-EU citizens, 2027-2028 round
records.organization: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Romania, with the Ministry of Education and Research (Study in Romania)
records.overview: Annual Romanian state scholarship programme for citizens of non-EU countries, for a bachelor's, master's or doctorate at accredited Romanian universities (all fields except medicine, dental medicine and pharmacy). Bachelor's and master's programmes are taught only in Romanian, with a funded Romanian-language preparatory year. The 2026 round (for 2026-2027) ran 16 February - 31 March 2026; the 2027-2028 round has not been announced on the portal.
records.program_dates: Academic year starting in autumn; master's programmes run 1, 1.5 or 2 years, preceded where required by a one-year Romanian-language preparatory year
records.deadline_text: Last round (2026-2027): 'Applications can be submitted only via the online platform, between 16 February 2026 and 31 March 2026, with the selection results being announced around 15 July 2026.' No 2027-2028 dates are published on the portal (read 21 November 2026).
records.expected_next_cycle: Not announced. The portal describes the programme as annual ('Each year, the Romanian Government ... provides a number of scholarships to citizens from non-EU countries'); the last round ran 16 February - 31 March 2026, so a similar window in early 2027 is possible but no date is published.
funding_details: Tuition for the studies is financed for no more than the duration of one university cycle
Tuition for the Romanian-language preparatory year is financed
A monthly scholarship is granted (amount not stated on the pages read)
Accommodation in student dormitories is financed within the Ministry's subsidy and subject to available places
Exemption from registration, application-processing and language-test fees
Airfare, visa, insurance and meals are not mentioned
records.participation_fee: None: scholarship holders are exempt from registration and application-processing fees
records.stipend: Monthly scholarship; amount not stated on the pages read
eligibility: Foreign citizens from all non-EU countries (exceptions: people of Romanian origin, people with protection in Romania, diplomatic/consular staff accredited to Romania and their families, staff of international organisations in Romania, holders of a Romanian state scholarship for the same cycle)
Average of at least 7 (Romanian scale) or 'Good' for the last school graduated
Not available for medicine, dental medicine or pharmacy
Master's programmes are addressed to holders of a first degree
nationality_requirements: Citizens of all non-EU countries, with listed exceptions; the DRC is not an EU country and is not among the exceptions
records.age_requirement: Unknown / Not specified (no age limit stated; parental consent only for under-18s)
records.education_requirement: For a master's: a completed first degree, with an average of at least 7 on the Romanian scale or 'Good'
records.language_requirement: Bachelor's and master's study only in Romanian; a funded Romanian-language preparatory year is required unless the applicant passes the Romanian language test or is otherwise exempt
other_requirements: Medical certificate of fitness for studies at enrolment
Passport with a long-stay study visa at enrolment
documents_required: Copies of diplomas (baccalaureate, bachelor's) with authorised translation into English, French, Spanish or Romanian
Other documents listed on the programme page
application_process: Create an account and apply only through the online platform scholarships.studyinromania.gov.ro during the announced window
Applications sent to ministries, embassies or by e-mail are rejected
Results by e-mail (last round: around 15 July); the Ministry of Education issues a letter of acceptance

records.eligibility_reason: The programme is open to 'Foreign citizens from all non-EU countries' with exceptions that do not concern the profile, so the DRC is eligible and the recorded bachelor's degree allows a master's application. The required average of at least 7 (Romanian scale) or 'Good' cannot be checked because the grade is not recorded, and the 2027-2028 round has not been announced.
potential_issues: 2027-2028 round not yet announced; the last deadline (31 March 2026) has passed
Master's study is only in Romanian: a preparatory language year adds a year abroad
Monthly stipend amount not stated on the pages read
Airfare, visa and insurance not mentioned
Dormitory accommodation only within subsidy limits and subject to available places
Grade average requirement (at least 7 / 'Good') cannot be checked against the profile
benefits: Tuition financed for the whole cycle
Dormitory accommodation within the ministry subsidy
Application, registration and language-test fees waived
records.relevance_reason: A government master's scholarship open to DRC nationals with no age or work-experience rule, in fields such as business, economics or international relations; the Romanian-language requirement and the unknown grade threshold lower the fit.

visa.support: Not specified; the programme page says visa formalities follow selection

notes: Phrases run: 8 plan (4 en, 2 fr, 1 pt, 1 es) + 8 own (4 en, 2 fr, 1 pt, 1 es). One new record: romania-mfa-scholarships-non-eu-2027 (recurring; 2027-28 round not announced; last deadline 2026-03-31). Its nationality criterion is MET on the organiser's sentence 'Foreign citizens from all non-EU countries' plus an exception list that does not cover the profile: judge.py raises review evidence-nationality-not-drc because the quote does not say 'all nationalities'; the DRC is not named but is a non-EU country. All evidence quotes were read with the repo reader and quotecheck --batch says found for all. Pages read only with WebFetch (not used for any record): exteriores.gob.es Maputo embassy page (MAEC-AECID África-Med; HTTP 0 to the repo reader); the Chile AGCID PDF was saved by WebFetch and read locally with pdftotext. NOT ELIGIBLE programmes logged without records: MAEC-AECID África-Med Máster (DRC listed but reserved for permanent public servants), Chile Beca Nelson Mandela 2027 (country list without the DRC; closed 30 Oct 2026), Czech government developing-countries scholarships (DRC not listed; closed 30 Sep 2026), Luiss Young Italian-African Diplomatic Fellowship (serving diplomats only), Chinese government scholarship via ENA-RDC (civil servants). Worth watching (not recorded, no official current-cycle page): Greek MFA scholarships via the Embassy of Greece in Kinshasa (mfa.gr 403 to both readers; one scholarship allocated to the DRC for 2026-27, deadline 27 July 2026 per search snippet - recurring, open it in a browser around June 2027); CAPES Move África (Brazil, 2,600 sandwich grants for African students in 2027, news only, needs current enrolment); Brunei BDGS 2027/28 (expected mid-December 2026; DRC position unconfirmed); Fulbright Foreign Student Program DRC 2027-28 (no official notice found); GKS graduate embassy track (normally February). ITEC (watchlist): itecgoi.in rule pages are empty JavaScript shells to both readers, DRC position not read. Reserved records: nothing new learned beyond the Mandela Washington Fellowship 2027 appearing in searches (not re-read). No scam-like items found. No lead outcomes (channel B had no leftover leads in the launch message). No source proposals: the official pages found are either static programme pages or blocked to the repo reader (exteriores.gob.es, boe.es, mfa.gr).
